channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Bilenky: Reportagem da Veja vem com alta carga de intenção eleitoral
item.description: Thais Bilenky analyzed the Veja report on a purported audio of Daniel Vorcaro, highlighting its high electoral intent. The columnist discussed how this content may influence the Brazilian political scenario.

item.title: AGU pede direito de resposta à Veja por reportagem sobre Lula
item.description: The AGU requested responding rights to Veja magazine after a report mentioned alleged funding for a documentary about Lula through Daniel Vorcaro's plea deal. The agency stated it seeks to clarify information published in the article.

item.title: Campanha de Lula vai processar revista Veja e Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Lula's campaign announced a lawsuit against Veja magazine and Daniel Vorcaro following a publication accusing the president of receiving kickbacks for financing a documentary. Camilo Santana described the report as a farce and highlighted lack of evidence, while the PGR and PF say Vorcaro did not give testimony with the statements released.

item.title: Grupo Lide, de Doria, fará almoço para Flávio Bolsonaro com 400 empresários a 6 dias da eleição
item.description: The Lide Group, led by João Doria, hosts a lunch for Flávio Bolsonaro with 400 business leaders at the W Hotel in São Paulo, six days before the election. The event brings together entrepreneurs and politicians to discuss the economy and government agenda.

item.title: Renan critica pressão para apoiar Flávio: “Temos dignidade”
item.description: Renan Santos, a candidate defeated in the first round, criticized the pressure to support Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff, stating he would not accept humiliation of followers and rejecting the 'herd effect'. He is the only major defeated candidate who has not yet endorsed Flávio, while Zema, Caiado, and Cury already did. Flávio and Lula face each other in the second round on October 25.

item.title: Brasileirão: Cruzeiro assume a liderança do returno; Corinthians é o último
item.description: After the 29th round of the Brazilian Championship, Cruzeiro leads the second half with 21 points, while Corinthians sits at the bottom with only five points. Cruzeiro won seven games and maintains a positive goal difference, overtaking teams like Flamengo and Santos. Corinthians, with seven consecutive losses, fired coach Fernando Diniz.

item.title: Gabriela Prioli faz balanço da política e revela voto: "Vocês já sabem"
item.description: Gabriela Prioli voiced support for Lula's policies, emphasizing the need to fight hunger and expand social rights like healthcare, education, and housing. She defended religious freedom and stressed the importance of state presence in supporting vulnerable populations.

item.title: Defesa de Vorcaro não reconhece autenticidade de áudio sobre filme de Lula
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro's defense team denied the authenticity of an audio allegedly linking the former banker to a R$5 million funding for a documentary about Lula. Lawyers stated they do not recognize the origin or integrity of the material, released as part of plea bargain negotiations. The case involves figures tied to corruption investigations and upcoming elections.

item.title: PL cria ‘Tropa do Flávio’, canal idealizado por Gayer, para revidar ‘Exército do Lula’ de Janones
item.description: The PL created the 'Tropa do Flávio' WhatsApp channel to counter André Janones' 'Exército do Lula', reaching 870,000 followers in three days. Led by Gustavo Gayer with content from Nikolas Ferreira and Pablo Marçal, the initiative aims to surpass the rival channel that already has 3 million participants.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro reage à possibilidade de pedido de extradição pela PF
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro reacted to the possibility of the Federal Police requesting his extradition after the Supreme Federal Court ordered the beginning of his sentence for coercion. The former federal deputy, who was abroad, now faces a new judicial phase that may impact his political life. The situation generates repercussions in the Brazilian political scenario.

item.title: Deputada eleita Ana Elisa virou grande tiro no pé da campanha de Lula no 2º turno
item.description: Elected federal deputy Ana Elisa became a key figure in Lula's campaign for the second round, but old posts on X (formerly Twitter) about taxing evangelical churches triggered backlash and threats, prompting her exit from social media. The PT campaign was frustrated by the negative reaction among evangelical voters, a group traditionally aligned with the PL. Despite this, Ana Elisa acknowledged some old posts and apologized, noting her views at 21 differ from those she expressed at 17.

item.title: PGR e PF: Vorcaro não depôs sobre financiamento de filme sobre Lula
item.description: The Brazilian Attorney General's Office and Federal Police denied that Daniel Vorcaro gave testimony matching the content reported by the magazine Veja regarding the financing of a film about Lula. According to the institutions, there was no oral testimony or submission of documents, and the immunity agreements proposed by the defense were rejected for not meeting legal requirements.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que vai manter Bolsa Família e Farmácia Popular
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he will maintain Bolsa Família and Farmácia Popular, arguing the former should target the poorest while including training programs. He promised home delivery of medications and denied disinformation about privatizing Petrobras or dismantling social programs.

item.title: Aposta de Lula nas redes, deputada mais votada do PT vira dor de cabeça por postagens antigas
item.description: After the first round, Lula's campaign bet on Ana Elisa Santos, the most voted PT candidate, to attract young voters on social media, but her old controversial posts resurfaced and harmed the campaign. Criticism of whites, support for social media censorship, and attacks on the right were repurposed by the opposition. Lula admitted the campaign is less organized than previous ones.

item.title: Torço para que não haja caos institucional se Flávio vencer, diz Kassab
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of PSD, expressed concern about potential institutional chaos between the Executive and Judiciary if Flávio Bolsonaro defeats Lula in the runoff. He stressed the importance of stable institutional relations regardless of the election outcome.

item.title: Em áudio, Daniel Vorcaro descreve reação de investigador da PGR ao ouvir sobre Lula
item.description: VEJA releases audio recordings where Daniel Vorcaro claims to have paid R$30 million in cash for a film about Lula and transferred funds to the Lula Institute, also describing the reaction of PGR investigators. The allegations sparked mixed reactions in the political sphere, while PGR and PF reject conflicting versions about the content of the conversations. The report raises concerns about disinformation and the veracity of information in an electoral context.

item.title: ‘Já empatamos o jogo nas redes e Lula será reeleito’, vaticina André Janones
item.description: André Janones claims Lula's reelection is secured and emphasizes the importance of digital mobilization for victory. He criticizes the elitist communication of the left and advocates for greater discipline on social media during the electoral campaign.

item.title: Renan Santos chama Cury de “comédia” após apoio a Flávio
item.description: Renan Santos criticized Augusto Cury after he endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round, calling him a 'comedy' and questioning his shift in stance. Cury, previously neutral, announced his support following first-round results, clarifying he would not join a potential government and that his backing includes a commitment to specific proposals.

item.title: PT diz haver queda no alcance de posts pró-Lula e vai ao TSE contra Meta
item.description: The 'Brasil Pronto pra Mais' coalition, led by the PT, filed allegations with the TSE accusing Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign of electoral misconduct, including reduced reach of pro-Lula posts on Meta and a cryptocurrency scheme rewarding pro-PL propaganda. The coalition demands equal treatment on social platforms and an investigation into the B22 token, which incentivizes shares supporting the PL candidate.

item.title: Governo zera impostos federais da gasolina por 30 dias
item.description: The federal government announced the suspension of federal taxes on gasoline for 30 days, eliminating PIS/Pasep, Cofins, and Cide, with a reduction of R$ 0,26 per liter. The measure also maintains ethanol tax relief and increases subsidies to producers, with an estimated cost of R$ 5.2 billion. The announcement comes 16 days before the second round of elections and will be offset by extraordinary oil revenues.

item.title: Suposto patrocínio a filme de Lula não é citado no celular de Vorcaro
item.description: Messages on Daniel Vorcaro's phone, from Banco Master, do not mention payment or sponsorship for a Lula documentary. The PF seized the device in November 2025 during the former banker's arrest.

item.title: Lula abre campanha do 2º turno em local bolsonarista e faz apelo contra 6x1
item.description: Lula resumed his campaign for the 2026 presidential runoff, facing Flávio Bolsonaro, who leads in polling. Speaking in a traditionally Bolsonaro stronghold, he called for unity among voters and warned against the risks of a fragmented vote.

item.title: Lula usa escala 6x1 para pressionar Flávio no segundo turno
item.description: Lula's campaign is expected to strengthen its message to workers and young people, advocating for the end of the 6x1 shift and proposing debates between the running mates. It also aims to deepen Flávio's ties with Vorcaro and mobilize low-income voters.

item.title: Com o otimismo eleitoral, Tesouro faz maior leilão de prefixados desde 2020
item.description: The National Treasury conducted the largest auction of fixed-rate bonds since 2020, raising R$33.3 billion, driven by market optimism following the first electoral round. The expectation of Flávio Bolsonaro's victory increased confidence in fiscal management, lowering future interest rates.

item.title: Lula critica uso da bandeira dos EUA em ato político: "Aqui ninguém tasca"
item.description: In his first campaign rally of the second round, President Lula criticized the display of the U.S. flag at political events, asserting that Brazil is sovereign and its wealth belongs to the people. He emphasized that 'nobody hires here,' reinforcing support for the Brazilian flag and national independence. The event in Ceilândia gathered supporters alongside DF gubernatorial candidate Leandro Grass.

item.title: A resposta de Cleitinho, governador eleito de MG, ao ser chamado de ‘esquerdista’
item.description: The elected governor of Minas Gerais, Cleitinho Azevedo, supports ending the 6×1 work shift, citing personal experience as a street vendor. He claims he is neither right nor left, but seeks social justice. Critics suggest his stance aligns with left-wing positions.

item.title: MP investiga caso do menino que comemorou resultado do 1° turno com arma de fogo na mão
item.description: Rio Grande do Norte Public Ministry opened two investigations after video showed child with firearm during first round election celebration. Inquiries examine weapon ownership, legality, and how minor accessed weapon. Incident occurred in Parnamirim with supporters of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: PT diz que reportagem da “Veja” é “peça eleitoral irresponsável”
item.description: The PT condemned a Veja magazine report alleging that former banker Daniel Vorcaro claimed R$30 million was funneled to the Lula Institute to finance a documentary about Lula, calling it an 'irresponsible electoral piece' without evidence. The coalition rejected the claims, stated there is no formal record of such testimony with authorities, and vowed to take legal action, arguing the report aims to disrupt the electoral process.

item.title: Prestes a oficializar vitória de Douglas Ruas, TRE suspende propaganda eleitoral no Rio
item.description: The Rio de Janeiro Electoral Court suspended free electoral advertising after the Superior Electoral Court annulled Anthony Garotinho's votes, which is expected to secure Douglas Ruas' (PL) victory in the first round. With Garotinho's votes discounted, Ruas surpasses 50% and is declared winner without a runoff.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: O caixa 2 do PT e Vorcaro para bancar um filme pra Lula
item.description: The Meio-Dia em Brasília program aired allegations from Daniel Vorcaro, former Banco Master controller, regarding a R$ 30 million investment in the Lula Institute to fund a documentary honoring Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The funds allegedly originated from the PT's 'caixa 2' and were kept outside official accounting, suggesting financial irregularities.

item.title: Horário eleitoral recomeça com Flávio falando em mudança, e Lula, em virada
item.description: Campaign time for the runoff election resumes with Lula warning against voting errors and Flávio Bolsonaro emphasizing change. Both candidates get five minutes on the main program plus ad insertions through October 23.

item.title: Lula, Macron e o paquiderme estatal
item.description: The text compares the relationship between Presidents Lula and Macron to a bromance, noting that both face elections with high government disapproval rates. Public dissatisfaction is presented as a common factor between the two leaders.

item.title: 1º e 2º turnos nas Eleições Presidenciais do Brasil (por Ricardo Guedes)
item.description: Lula lost the first round due to structural issues like stagnant economy and high debt, plus situational factors such as the STF crisis. The political center moved away, favoring Flávio Bolsonaro. The election is defined by strategic voting and mutual rejection.

item.title: Augusto Cury: o vendedor de sonhos que comprou um Dark Horse
item.description: Augusto Cury, psychiatrist and author of over 30 million books sold, launched a 2026 presidential campaign embodying his image as a dream seller and critic of power, but ended up aligning with conservative figures like Tarcísio de Freitas and Ricardo Nunes. During the campaign, he abandoned principles from his books, such as resistance to hyperconnectivity and political independence, becoming a product of media machinery and algorithms. The article suggests a disconnect between Cury’s moralizing discourse and his political actions.

item.title: PT afirma que delação sobre documentário para Lula é peça de propaganda para Flávio
item.description: The PT rejected a Veja magazine article linking banker Daniel Vorcaro to an alleged R$30 million payment to fund a documentary about President Lula, calling the publication an 'irresponsible electoral piece'. The party stated the article presents serious accusations without evidence and aims to damage Lula's image.

item.title: Vice de Douglas Ruas no Rio é ex-Zorra Total e já foi miss
item.description: Fernanda Louback, a former model and Miss Rio de Janeiro, was announced as the running mate of Douglas Ruas (PL) for Rio de Janeiro governor, following the annulment of Garotinho's (Republicans) votes by the TSE. With a background in TV (Zorra Total) and as a councilwoman in Niterói, she is part of a ticket likely to be elected in the first round.

item.title: Janones, Caneta Azul e apoios no segundo turno: o que os brasileiros pesquisaram no Google após a eleição
item.description: Following the first round of elections, Brazilians searched most about the second-round date, gubernatorial results, senators, and how to justify a vote. Governors were elected in 20 states and 54 senators were chosen, including Tarcísio de Freitas, Cleitinho, and Jerônimo Rodrigues. Key public queries focused on political endorsements, lawmakers' salaries, and voting rights.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio contam com Cleitinho como cabo eleitoral em MG
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) expect that Cleitinho (Republicanos), elected governor of Minas Gerais, will act as a electoral officer for the bolsonarist in the state. The expectation is that he will contribute to Flávio's victory in the region, strengthening the alliance between PL and Republicanos in MG.

item.title: Lula diz que 2º turno terá 'muito debate na TV e na internet': 'Estou virando o rei da selfie'
item.description: Lula stated that the runoff will feature intense debates on TV and the internet and joked about becoming the 'selfie king'. During a campaign walk in Ceilândia, he criticized the Master Bank and BRB, highlighting his digital strategy and rejecting what he called 'fascism' and corruption. He also emphasized national sovereignty and criticized the opposition for supporting the American flag.

item.title: Relatório do STF identifica na rede X ameaças de fuzilamento, esquartejamento e enforcamento de ministros
item.description: An internal Supreme Federal Court report identified threats of execution, hanging, dismemberment and explosions against justices on social media platform X, with some messages posted after the first round of the 2026 elections.

item.title: As sinalizações da campanha de Lula sobre o ajuste fiscal
item.description: Lula's campaign faces pressure to clarify its fiscal stance after criticism of his anti-surplus remarks. The PT fears losing ground in the fiscal debate to Flávio Bolsonaro. Lula advocates for fiscal stability without indiscriminate cuts, prioritizing social programs.

item.title: Lula indica ida a debates no segundo turnos e volta a se contrapor a Flávio Bolsonaro com defesa do fim da escala 6x1
item.description: Lula advocates for reducing the workday and criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro, calling for the arrest of 'BRB thieves'. He uses fear-based strategies, warning against setbacks in social policies and announcing participation in debates for the second round.

item.title: Crusoé: Filme do Lula ou Dark Horse? Qual o mais sujo?
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro admitted, in a plea bargain attempt, to financing a documentary about President Lula produced by Oliver Stone. The Veja magazine report, released during the second-round campaign, raises suspicions of image laundering and political influence. The case underscores polarization and corruption allegations in the electoral context.

item.title: Prerrogativas aciona PF por suposta articulação de Vorcaro com campanha de Flávio
item.description: Members of the group Prerrogativas filed a report with the Federal Police requesting investigation into alleged coordination between Daniel Vorcaro and Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign. The suspicion involves intermediaries of the former owner of Banco Master and figures close to the senator. The case reinforces probes into foreign capital influence in politics. The article was first published on O Antagonista.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro defende retirada do split payment e reajuste da aposentadoria acima da inflação
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro advocates for the removal of the split payment mechanism, arguing it harms companies' cash flow and could trigger widespread bankruptcies. He also pledged to adjust pensions above inflation, rejecting PT allegations of pension cuts.

item.title: A vitória de Flávio na Justiça Eleitoral contra Janones e Lindbergh Farias
item.description: TSE minister André Mendonça ordered deputies André Janones and Lindbergh Farias to remove social media posts claiming Flávio Bolsonaro intends to raise retirement age, unlink pensions from minimum wage, implement 7×0 work schedule, and privatize Petrobras, ruling these statements wrongly attribute non-existent proposals to the senator. The decision favored Flávio, who filed the lawsuit with the Electoral Court. Both lawmakers face a R$10,000 fine for non-compliance.

item.title: Mensagens indicam atuação de advogado próximo ao governo Lula para salvar o Master
item.description: Messages found on Daniel Vorcaro's phone show lawyer Walfrido Warde intermediated contacts with Lula's government officials to prevent Banco Master's insolvency, per Veja magazine. The case is under investigation for suspected corruption and undue influence.

item.title: O nome do União Brasil que é dado como certo em um eventual ministério de Flávio
item.description: União Brasil leaders suggest ACM Neto as a potential minister if Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) wins, emphasizing his strategic support in the Northeast. The Salvador rally gathers opposition figures, reinforcing political alliances for the electoral race. The indication reflects negotiations for government composition.

item.title: Projeto que nasceu de encontro entre Criolo, Amaro Freitas e Dino vira doc
item.description: Collaborative musical project between Criolo, Amaro Freitas and Dino d'Santiago resulted in an album and documentary 'O Som Entre Nós', highlighting cultural resistance and ancestry. The artists explore sonic connections of the Black Atlantic, with a performance scheduled for the 2026 Festival Estilo Brasil in Brasília.

item.title: "Feira com Lula" e "Onda da Leoa": Ceilândia recebe Celina e Grass nesta 6ª
item.description: The candidates for Governor of the Federal District Leandro Grass (PT) and Celina Leão (PP) hold parallel campaign events in Ceilândia on Friday (10/9). Celina leads the race with 55% of voting intentions, against 37% for Grass, according to a Datafolha poll released on Thursday (10/8).
